config.record_grain: One row per current Australian Financial Services licensee register entry, with one licence and its reported licensee identifiers, start date, principal business address components and conditions.

fields.evidence: Help File p.8: AFS_LIC_NUM is a unique identifying number allocated to the Australian Financial Services licensee; sample header AFS_LIC_NUM, value 218600.

Help File p.8: AFS_LIC_NAME is the register entry name of the Australian Financial Services licensee; sample header AFS_LIC_NAME, value IPIB PTY LTD. The field is retained as a register name, not assumed to be a legal name.
Help File p.8: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's ABN or ACN, with ABN shown if provided; sample header AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN, value 85007186003. ABN validation only; no type inferred from suffix.

Help File p.8: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's ABN or ACN, with ACN shown if no ABN is provided; sample header AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN, value 85007186003. ACN validation only; no ACN inferred from an ABN suffix.

Help File p.8: AFS_LIC_START_DT is the start date of the Australian Financial Services licensee, date format DD/MM/YYYY; sample header AFS_LIC_START_DT, value 02/05/2002. Mapped as licence start date, not entity registration date.

Help File p.9: AFS_LIC_PRE_FSR contains a previous register identifier and licence number, with multiple previous licences delimited by '~'; sample header AFS_LIC_PRE_FSR, value "General insurance broker","000030366". Preserve raw payload without unsafe parsing.

Help File p.11: AFS_LIC_CONDITION gives current financial services and products authorised under the licence and documents tilde-delimited output formats; sample header AFS_LIC_CONDITION, value begins "This licence authorises the licensee to carry on a financial services business to:". Preserve source payload without parsing embedded formats.
Help File p.9: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is the locality of the current principal business address; sample header AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL, value SOUTHBANK.
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is the state of the current principal business address; sample header AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE, value VIC. Source abbreviations align with ontology state categories.
Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is the postcode of the current principal business address; sample header AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE, value 3006. Retain as a string.

Help File p.10: AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is the country of the principal business address; countries outside Australia are set to International; sample header AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY, value Australia. Omit International placeholder.

unmapped_fields.reason: Register label (sample value AFS Licence); no ontology field represents this register-name metadata.

limitations: The dataset/help file describes a current-register snapshot. No status column is supplied, so no row-level current-status filter can be expressed; this mapping does not infer historical status or completeness beyond the dataset documentation.

AFS_LIC_NAME can display either an individual's name or an organisation name (Help File p.8); it is mapped only as the licence register entry name and retained as subject_label_field, not asserted as entity.legal_name.
AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is mixed ABN/ACN. Separate checksum-validating operations may emit the applicable identifier; do not infer ACN from an ABN suffix. The row does not establish legal form.
AFS_LIC_START_DT is a licence start date and is not company registration date.

AFS_LIC_PRE_FSR and AFS_LIC_CONDITION contain structured, potentially multi-value text with embedded delimiters/quotes. They are retained as raw text; no individual historical reference or condition rows are parsed.

Principal business address data has no street component; address locality, state, postcode and country claims may be blank where address validation failed (Help File pp.9-10). International country placeholder is omitted.
Publication proxy is the supplied snapshot observation time, not a claim that each row changed at that time; source envelope supplies timestamp and licence.
